RULE-1.gloss: Distance equals speed times time per segment
RULE-1.formula: ∀j ∀seg ∀s ∀t ∀d((SegmentSpeed(j, seg, s) ∧ SegmentTime(j, seg, t) ∧ Multiply(s, t, d)) → SegmentDistance(j, seg, d))

RULE-2.gloss: Total distance is the sum of four segment distances using Add4
RULE-2.formula: ∀j ∀a1 ∀a2 ∀a3 ∀a4 ∀t((SegmentDistance(j, segment1, a1) ∧ SegmentDistance(j, segment2, a2) ∧ SegmentDistance(j, segment3, a3) ∧ SegmentDistance(j, segment4, a4) ∧ Add4(a1, a2, a3, a4, t)) → TotalDistance(j, t))

INF-1.gloss: SegmentDistance(john, segment1, n_180) from FACT-1, FACT-2, FACT-3 by RULE-1

INF-2.gloss: SegmentDistance(john, segment3, n_15) from FACT-4, FACT-5, FACT-6 by RULE-1

INF-3.gloss: SegmentDistance(john, segment4, n_280) from FACT-7, FACT-8, FACT-9 by RULE-1

INF-4.gloss: TotalDistance(john, n_475) from INF-1, FACT-11, INF-2, INF-3, and FACT-12 by RULE-2
